components.name: Text Field

components.name: Status
components.description: A 7px square and a word; colour only for authorization meaning.
components.html: Autorisée En attente Bloquée
components.css: .ds-st { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-right: 12px; font: 500 12px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-st::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-st.ok { color: #3fcf8e; } .ds-st.ok::before { background: #3fcf8e; } .ds-st.warn { color: #f0a63c; } .ds-st.warn::before { background: #f0a63c; } .ds-st.bad { color: #ff7389; } .ds-st.bad::before { background: #ff3d5e; }

components.name: Proposal and Decision
components.description: Signature: AI proposal in a dashed neutral line; human decision in solid ink.
components.html:
Proposé par l’IAIntervenant A · voix féminine, 3 prises de parole
Confirmé par Nour FilmsAmel · personnage principal

narrative.overview: SAWTI 360 is a production tool in which every decision is witnessed. The interface reads like a lit studio at night, matched to the public home page: hairline rules instead of shadows, numerals and identifiers set as facts, and the Passeport 360° seal as the one emblem. Anything a machine proposes is drawn with a neutral dashed hairline; anything a person has decided is drawn solid in paper ink. Ember Orange marks what you can act on or have selected; green, amber, rose and sky carry status.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ink on night surfaces; hairlines carry structure, shadows only lift overlays.
Dashed neutral line = AI proposal; solid paper-ink line = human decision.
One action colour, Ember Orange; status colours only for authorization and information states.
One type family with an Arabic companion; monospace only for timecodes, hashes and identifiers.
Every piece of data says what it is: Réel, Simulé, Exemple or Prévu.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Ember Orange means "you can act on this, or you selected it". It never marks an AI proposal, a decoration or an inactive state.

rules.name: The Machine Is Grey Rule
rules.body: AI proposals are neutral and dashed. They become solid paper ink only once a person confirms them.

rules.name: The Mono Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for values that are measured or verified. Never use it as a "technical" costume on labels, step numbers, initials or the brand.

rules.name: The Heading Speaks Alone Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow, kicker or label above a heading. Context goes in the breadcrumb or in the line under the title.

rules.name: The Hairline Grid Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from 1px rules and alignment, not from boxes. Use proximity and a rule before adding a container.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow except controls that need lift and layers that float.

rules.name: The Square Status Rule
rules.body: States are a small square and a word. No rounded pills, no tinted badges.

rules.name: The Rose Is Not Orange Rule
rules.body: Errors and blocks use the rose red, never a red-orange that could be mistaken for the accent.

dos: Do draw every AI proposal with the dashed machine line and turn it solid ink when a person confirms it.
Do keep Ember Orange for actions, links, focus and selection only.
Do label data provenance (Réel, Simulé, Exemple, Prévu) wherever data is shown.
Do use Plex Mono for timecodes, hashes, signatures and identifiers, and tabular figures for counts and money.
Do separate groups with 1px rules and spacing before reaching for a new container.
Do keep status as a 7px square plus a word, with green, amber and red only for authorization meaning.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't use a coloured border-left or border-right stripe on callouts, list items or nav items.
Don't number sections (01 / 02) unless the order itself is information, such as the project steps or a process.
Don't build page structure from same-size icon + title + text tiles.
Don't nest cards, or wrap form controls in more than one bordered layer.
Don't use monospace, gradients, glass or glows as decoration.
Don't colour an AI-generated voice or proposal in the action orange.
